title: Create rooms and scenes API endpoints
description:
Create chatbot/api/rooms.py exposing a FastAPI APIRouter with endpoints for room management (create, list, get, update memory policy, delete), scene lifecycle (create, get, update, pause, resume, end, active scene), and roleplay persona management.

Before editing, inspect:
- AGENTS.md
- docs/plans_tasks.md
- docs/architecture.md
- chatbot/api/__init__.py (existing API package init)
- chatbot/rooms/room.py (created by task b.1 — Room, RoomType, RoomMemoryPolicy, create_room, get_room, get_user_rooms, update_room_memory_policy)
- chatbot/rooms/scene.py (created by task b.2 — SceneState, all scene lifecycle functions)
- chatbot/rooms/roleplay.py (created by task b.4 — RoleplayPersona, RoleplayEngine)
- chatbot/db/models.py (updated by task b.3 — Room and Scene models)
- Existing API endpoint files (chatbot/api/chat.py, chatbot/api/sessions.py, chatbot/api/memory.py) for router pattern conventions

Do not infer APIs, constructor signatures, function names, module locations, or service topology from the task description alone. Inspect the referenced documents and existing implementation files first, then implement against the actual repository.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY chatbot/api/rooms.py. Do NOT modify any other file under any circumstance. Do NOT update documentation, READMEs, operations guides, or any code outside the listed path. If you believe other files need updating, ignore that impulse and finish the task with only the listed file modified. Out-of-scope edits will cause the task to be rejected.

Implementation details:

1. Create chatbot/api/rooms.py with:
   - Module docstring: 'Room and scene management API endpoints.'
   - A FastAPI APIRouter instance named `rooms_router` with prefix '/rooms' and tag 'rooms'.
   - Pydantic request/response models:
     * RoomCreateRequest: user_id (str), room_type (RoomType), display_name (str | None), companion_id (str | None)
     * RoomResponse: room_id, user_id, companion_id, room_type, display_name, memory_policy (dict), scene_id, created_at, metadata
     * RoomListResponse: rooms (list[RoomResponse])
     * MemoryPolicyUpdateRequest: persist_to_durable (bool | None), scope (str | None), max_context_turns (int | None), include_embeddings (bool | None)
     * SceneCreateRequest: room_id (str), location (str), activity (str)
     * SceneUpdateRequest: location (str | None), activity (str | None), tone (str | None), intensity (int | None), scene_context (str | None), participants (list[str] | None)
     * SceneResponse: all SceneState fields as JSON
     * PersonaRequest: name (str), description (str), traits (list[str]), voice_style (str), backstory (str), scene_goals (list[str]), constraints (list[str])
     * ScenePromptResponse: system_prompt (str)
     * MemoryClassificationResponse: classification (Literal['scene_only', 'durable', 'both'])

   - Room endpoints:
     * POST /rooms/ — create a new room. Returns RoomResponse.
     * GET /rooms/{user_id} — list all rooms for a user. Returns RoomListResponse.
     * GET /rooms/detail/{room_id} — get single room details. Returns RoomResponse.
     * PUT /rooms/{room_id}/memory-policy — update room memory policy. Returns RoomResponse.
     * DELETE /rooms/{room_id} — delete a room and associated scenes.

   - Scene endpoints:
     * POST /rooms/{room_id}/scenes — create a new scene in a room. Returns SceneResponse.
     * GET /rooms/{room_id}/scenes/active — get the active scene. Returns SceneResponse or 404.
     * GET /scenes/{scene_id} — get scene details. Returns SceneResponse or 404.
     * PATCH /scenes/{scene_id} — update scene fields. Returns SceneResponse.
     * POST /scenes/{scene_id}/pause — pause scene. Returns SceneResponse.
     * POST /scenes/{scene_id}/resume — resume scene. Returns SceneResponse.
     * POST /scenes/{scene_id}/end — end scene. Returns SceneResponse.

   - Roleplay endpoints:
     * POST /scenes/{scene_id}/persona — set or update persona for a scene. Returns ScenePromptResponse with the built system prompt.
     * POST /scenes/{scene_id}/classify — classify a text string for memory importance. Takes text (str) in body, returns MemoryClassificationResponse.

   All endpoints delegate to functions in chatbot.rooms.* modules. Do not implement business logic directly in the router.
acceptance_criteria: chatbot/api/rooms.py exists with rooms_router and all Pydantic models
POST /rooms/ creates a room and returns RoomResponse
POST /scenes/{scene_id}/persona returns system prompt from RoleplayEngine
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use FastAPI APIRouter with prefix and tag
use dependency injection for database sessions
return standard HTTP status codes (201 for create, 200 for read/update, 204 for delete, 404 for not found)
delegate all business logic to chatbot.rooms.* module functions
forbidden: add middleware, auth, rate-limiting, or CORS to this router
implement business logic directly in endpoint handlers
return raw database rows or SQLAlchemy objects in responses
